title: MES batch extraction result
description: Response of POST /api/v1/extract/batch/. One entry per uploaded file, in upload order. An entry carries either the unchanged mes-result document of that file (result) or the reasons the file could not be processed (errors); one failing file never affects the others. The XML representation (mes-batch.xsd) carries the same content.

index.description: Position of the file in the upload, starting at 0.
